title: The Chosen Immortal Clan
summary: The survivors land on a coast in the Allheaven Star System, and storytellers spread the tale of how Xu Mu killed three Thunder Celestial Temple envoys and broke their formation to save countless lives, though everyone was scattered at random and his whereabouts are unknown. In the Zhan family's hall, clan head Zhan Lie Yunzi decides the family should neither get too close to Xu Mu nor make him an enemy. Wang Lin has landed in an unknown region of Western Allheaven, a land sealed in living fog that blocks even divine sense, and after three days he reaches Reed Marsh, home of the Chosen Immortal Clan, whose people speak their own Chosen Immortal tongue. Seeing the Wither Dao Pair, the clan head takes him for a messenger of Celestial King Xiaoyao Zi, who ordered the clan to guard the Xuanyin Tripod for thirty thousand years, and Wang Lin realises they do not know the Celestial Realm has fallen. The altar guardian Ta Shan, who calls the clan head grandfather and resents the immortals, attacks him with the Thirteen Leaves warrior curse and the Scattered Devil armor, and Wang Lin beats him without killing him. When fog beasts break the clan's formation, Wang Lin uses his Yellow Springs Dao and the Wither Dao Pair to kill even the human-shaped ones that copy their attackers' arts, and asks to be taken to the tripod.
